devdoc.details: Packed fish layout (euint32): tier bits 0-2 | species bits 3-4 | aura bit 5 | weight bits 8-15 | valid bit 16.      packed == 0 is "Sandal Jepit" (bait not paid). Tiers: 0 Biasa, 1 Langka, 2 Epik, 3 Legenda, 4 Secret.

SambarBlocked(uint8).details: 1 thief has not cast enough, 2 thief cooldown, 3 victim has the newcomer shield, 4 pair cooldown,      5 victim cooldown, 6 victim hourly limit, 7 victim bucket too small, 8 fish not targetable,      9 cannot snatch from yourself, 10 NPC restock not due

devdoc.title: DeepSecretGame — confidential multiplayer fishing (GAME_SPEC.md §6, §10).

InvalidKMSSignatures().notice: Returned if the returned KMS signatures are not valid.

SenderNotAllowedToUseHandle(bytes32,addr.notice: Returned if the sender is not allowed to use the handle.

ZamaProtocolUnsupported().notice: Returned if the Zama protocol is not supported on the current chain

PublicDecryptionVerified(bytes32[],bytes.notice: This event is emitted when public decryption has been successfully verified.

Snatched(address,address,uint256,uint256.notice: Who snatched from whom, which fish was targeted and which record the thief received. Never the result.

PAK_KUMIS().notice: Pak Kumis, the NPC whose bucket anyone can practise on. No key exists for this address.

activeKeyOf(address).notice: The key currently allowed to play for `who`, or zero. PearlCoin uses it to share balance reads.

authorizeSession(address,uint64).notice: Let `key` play for you until `expiresAt`: cast, sell, upgrade and flex without a wallet popup.         Fish, coins and NFTs stay yours. The key gets read access to your newest bucket fish and to your         balance, and any ETH sent along is forwarded to it for gas.

cast(uint8).notice: Pay one bait and roll five encrypted fish. A short balance does not revert: the five fish become         Sandal Jepit, so the transaction never reveals whether the player could pay.

endSeason().notice: After the season closes anyone can open the hidden Secret counter, proving the quota was respected.

finalizeFlex(uint256,bytes,bytes).notice: Step 2 (anyone can submit): verify the KMS proof. A Secret becomes a 1-of-1 NFT and goes to the         Public Aquarium; anything else goes back to the bucket.

finalizeRodUpgrade(address,bytes,bytes).notice: Step 2 (anyone can submit): verify the KMS-signed "paid" bit and raise the public rod level if paid.

flex(uint256).notice: Step 1 of showing off a fish: its packed attributes become publicly decryptable.

oddsFor(uint8,uint8).notice: The public odds table as cumulative 32-bit thresholds: a fish is Secret if r < secret,         Legenda if r < legend, Epik if r < epic, Langka if r < rare, else Biasa.

requestRodUpgrade().notice: Step 1 of a rod upgrade: pay under encryption, then the "paid" bit is opened for public decryption.

restockNpc().notice: Refill Pak Kumis's practice bucket (anyone can call when it runs low): six fish from the Dermaga         table without Secrets, and a net hidden by on-chain randomness.

secretsLeftHandle().notice: Handle of the hidden Secret counter. Only this contract may decrypt it until the season ends.

sell(uint256[]).notice: Sell fish from your bucket. The payout is the encrypted sum of their prices; nobody sees it.         Secret fish are priced at 0 and must not be sold (the app never offers it).

setNet(bytes32,bytes).notice: Hide your net under one fish id (encrypted input). Any id is allowed, so a net can also be a bluff.

snatch(address,uint256).notice: Pay a bait and blindly snatch one fish from someone's bucket. You always get a sack: the fish, or a         Sandal Jepit if the slot was guarded by the owner's hidden net, was a Secret (immune), or you could not         pay. Nobody but you learns which; the owner learns only about their own slot.

userdoc.notice: What stays encrypted: every catch (species, weight, aura, tier, sale price), coin balances, and how many         Secret fish are left this season. What is public: the odds table, rod levels, zones, who cast when, and         Secret fish whose owners chose to show them off (verified by a KMS decryption proof).         There is no admin: odds, quota and prices are fixed for the whole season at deployment.
